_comment: MediHistory AI staging security group — import into AWS Console or use with AWS CLI
_usage: aws ec2 create-security-group --group-name medihistory-staging --description 'MediHistory AI staging' && aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id SG_ID --cli-input-json file://security-group.json

IpRanges._comment: REPLACE with your IP: curl ifconfig.me

_note: Port 8000 (FastAPI) is intentionally NOT in this security group. Nginx proxies inbound traffic to localhost:8000 — the app is never directly exposed.
